product_overview: Backend control plane for ForgeGraph: a Django REST API that manages authentication, graph authoring/validation/versioning, run lifecycle coordination with the Go engine, governance/analytics, and marketplace/integration surfaces for tenant operations.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication and SSO entry points for tenants and users (JWT lifecycle: register, login, refresh, logout).
Enable graph authoring, structural validation, versioning, and idempotent external-workflow imports with stable graph JSON contracts.
Orchestrate run lifecycle operations (start, invoke, stream, resume, replay, cancel) and coordinate callbacks with the Go engine via gRPC and engine callback endpoints.
Expose memory, analytics, approvals, audit logs, and policy guardrails to support tenant governance, retention, and observability.
Support marketplace, credential management, billing, and external integration testing flows for tenant runtime and tooling.

features.name: Authentication and Identity
features.description: User registration, login/logout, token refresh, profile lookup, and SSO provider metadata for ForgeGraph control plane access.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with {email,password} -> Receive 201 with a top-level user payload and no tokens -> POST /api/auth/login with same credentials -> Receive 200 with an access token in JSON and refresh_token as an HttpOnly cookie -> GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 with user profile -> POST /api/auth/refresh using the refresh cookie -> Receive 200 with refreshed access token -> POST /api/auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 204 and clear the refresh cookie
GET /api/auth/sso/provider -> Receive 200 with SSO provider metadata

POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Authentication failed -> GET /api/auth/me without Authorization header -> Receive 401 -> POST /api/auth/refresh with missing refresh cookie may receive 400 -> POST /api/auth/refresh with invalid refresh token -> Receive 401 Invalid refresh token

features.name: Graph Authoring and Validation
features.description: Create, validate, version, fetch and import external workflow graphs using the GraphValidator and stable Graph JSON contracts.
user_flows: POST /api/graphs/validate with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and body {graph_json,strict?} -> Receive 200 validation result -> POST /api/graphs/ with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and body {name,description?} -> Receive 201 data-wrapped graph metadata with version_count=0 and latest_version=null -> POST /api/graphs/{graph_id}/versions with {graph_json} -> Receive 201 data-wrapped graph version -> GET /api/graphs/ with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 graph list including new graph

POST /api/graphs/validate with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and invalid semantic graph payload -> Receive 200 validation result with data.valid=false -> POST /api/graphs/ with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and invalid payload -> Receive 400 Validation error -> GET /api/graphs/{nonexistent_id} with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 404 Graph not found

features.name: Run Lifecycle and Engine Coordination
features.description: Start and manage workflow runs, stream and inspect run events, resume/replay/cancel runs, and receive engine callback events for run state updates.
user_flows: POST /api/runs/start with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and body {graph_version_id,input_json?} -> Receive 201 data-wrapped run detail with run_id/status -> GET /api/runs/{run_id} with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 run detail -> GET /api/runs/{run_id}/events with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 run event list -> GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 event stream (SSE/WebSocket established) -> POST /api/runs/{run_id}/cancel with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 cancel result
POST /api/runs/invoke with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and invocation payload -> Receive 200 Run accepted

POST /api/runs/start with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and nonexistent graph_version_id -> Receive 404 -> POST /api/runs/engine-events with invalid or missing HMAC signature headers -> Receive 401

features.name: Memory, Analytics, and Governance APIs
features.description: Expose memory usage, stored observations, tenant analytics, approvals, audit logs, and policy guardrails to support governance, retention, and observability.
user_flows: GET /api/memory/usage with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 memory usage summary -> POST /api/memory/observations with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and body {observation} -> Receive 200 observation detail -> GET /api/memory/observations with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 observation list -> GET /api/analytics/memory/usage with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 memory analytics -> GET /api/analytics/llm/usage with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 LLM usage analytics -> GET /api/policies/guardrails with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 policy payload -> GET /api/approvals with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 approval list -> GET /api/audit-logs with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 audit log list
POST /api/memory/observations with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and invalid payload -> Receive 400 Validation error -> GET /api/memory/usage without Authorization header -> Receive 401

features.name: Marketplace, Credentials, Billing, and Integrations
features.description: Tenant-scoped marketplace and runtime package listing, credential storage and OAuth bootstrap, billing plans, and integration testing helpers.
user_flows: GET /api/marketplace/packages with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 marketplace package list -> GET /api/marketplace/installed with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 installed package list -> GET /api/credentials with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 credential list -> POST /api/credentials/oauth/start with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 OAuth start payload -> GET /api/billing/plans with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> -> Receive 200 billing plan list -> POST /api/integrations/http/test with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and valid test payload -> Receive 200 integration test result

POST /api/integrations/http/test with Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> and invalid body -> Receive 400 Validation error -> POST /api/credentials/oauth/start without Authorization header -> Receive 401

endpoints.description: Register a new user account.

Refresh an access token using the refresh_token cookie.

features.name: Graph Authoring and Validation
features.description: CRUD and validation APIs for workflow graphs, versions, templates, and external workflow imports.

endpoints.description: List workflow graphs visible to the current tenant or user.
Create workflow graph metadata. Versions are created separately.
Validate a graph payload before saving or running it.
Create a durable graph version from graph_json.
Fetch a single graph and its metadata.
Import or update external workflows idempotently.

features.name: Run Lifecycle and Engine Coordination
features.description: Start, invoke, stream, resume, replay, cancel, and inspect workflow runs while coordinating with the Go engine.

endpoints.description: List runs for the current tenant or user.
Start a graph run through the engine.
Start a run from an invocation-style payload.
Return run detail and current status.
Return run events captured for a run.
Stream run events for a run.
Resume a paused or approval-blocked run.
Replay a completed or failed run from checkpoints.
Cancel an active run.
Receive signed server-to-server callback events from the engine runtime. Events are transport artifacts; backend persistence remains authoritative.

response_schema.200: Signed callback accepted and data-wrapped response returned; duplicate event_ids return data.duplicate=true
response_schema.401: Invalid or missing engine callback signature

endpoints.description: Return memory usage metrics.

Return tenant memory analytics.
Return model usage analytics.
List pending or historical human approval items.

features.name: Marketplace, Credentials, Billing, and Integrations

endpoints.description: List marketplace packages available to the tenant.

known_limitations.issue: Some features depend on external services such as PostgreSQL, Redis, billing providers, OAuth providers, or the Go engine to behave like production.
known_limitations.impact: Full end-to-end behavior can differ from isolated local execution unless dependencies are configured.

known_limitations.issue: Run behavior spans synchronous APIs, async callbacks, and streaming/event flows.
known_limitations.impact: Tests need deterministic fixtures and orchestration to avoid flaky integration coverage.
